seeds.text: Your team needs you the weekend of a family event you promised to attend. What do you do, and what do you tell each side?
followUpHints: Who did you actually call first?
What did you tell the side you let down?

seeds.text: Rank these when they collide: being honest, being kind, being loyal, being right. Then tell me about a time your top two collided.
followUpHints: Which one did you drop, in the real example?
Would you rank them the same way today?

seeds.text: A close friend asks to borrow money you'd set aside for a trip you were looking forward to. What do you do?
followUpHints: What did you say to them in the moment?
Did you tell them it was trip money?

seeds.text: Tell me about a time someone took credit for your work. What did you do?
followUpHints: Did you say anything to them directly?
What did you wish you'd done instead?

seeds.text: You find a rule at work or in a group is clearly producing an unfair result in one case. Following it hurts someone; breaking it risks you. What do you do?
followUpHints: Did you follow the rule or break it, the last time this came up?
Who carried the cost of your choice?

seeds.text: Someone you care about asks your honest opinion on something they've worked hard on, and you think it's weak. What do you actually say?
followUpHints: What were your exact first words?
Did you soften it, and why?

seeds.text: Tell me about a promise you kept even though it ended up costing you more than you expected.
followUpHints: Was there a moment you considered backing out?
Why did you hold to it?

seeds.text: Rank what you protect first when life gets tight: your health, your close relationships, your work, your freedom to choose. Then give me a time two of these fought.
followUpHints: Which did you sacrifice?
Did it feel like the right call afterward?

seeds.text: You can help a stranger in real need, but only by giving up something that mattered to someone close to you. How do you decide?
followUpHints: Has a version of this actually happened to you?
What tipped it one way?

seeds.text: Tell me about a time you stood your ground on something when it would have been far easier to let it go.
followUpHints: What exactly did you refuse to do?
What did it cost you?

seeds.text: Tell me about a time you realized partway through that you were in the wrong. What did you do next?
followUpHints: Did you admit it, and to whom?
How quickly?

seeds.text: A friend does something you think is genuinely wrong and asks you to keep it between you. Do you keep it? What would change your answer?
followUpHints: Where exactly is your line?
Have you ever crossed your own line here?
